title: Subaru of America, Inc.: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR (147,000 affected)
summary: THE INNER ARMS OF THE REAR SUSPENSION ARE SUBJECT TO CORROSION IN AREAS WHERE ROAD SALT IS USED HEAVILY IN WINTER.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC (10,800 affected)
summary: FUEL FILLER HOSES MAY HAVE BEEN CUT PRIOR TO INSTALLATION BY A UTILITY KNIFE USED TO OPEN THE SHIPPING BOX.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: FUEL:FUEL LINES:HOSES:NON-METALLIC (4,900 affected)
summary: FUEL FILLER HOSES MAY HAVE BEEN CUT PRIOR TO INSTALLATION BY A UTILITY KNIFE USED TO OPEN THE SHIPPING BOX.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:FUSE AND FUSE RECEPTICLE (15,900 affected)
summary: THE 80-AMPERE FUSIBLE LINK LOCATED IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT CAN DEVELOP MECHANICAL WEAKNESS DUE TO AGING AND THERMAL STRESSES, AND CAN BREAK.

title: International Motors, LLC: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:CAP:FILLER (1,184 affected)
summary: THE FUEL CAP MAY NOT LOCK OR SEAL PROPERLY.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (149 affected)
summary: THE AIR LINE PLUMBING OF THE AIR BRAKE FOOT VALVE WAS CONNECTED TO THE SUPPLY RESERVOIR INSTEAD OF THE PRIMARY RESERVOIR. THIS REMOVES THE PRIMARY BRAKE SYSTEM AS A BACK-UP IN THE EVENT OF A SECONDARY BRAKE SYSTEM FAILURE.

title: ELK AUTOMOTIVE, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACK ANCHORS AND SEATS (1,000 affected)
summary: THE MID-POSITION SEAT PEDESTAL LOCKING PIN ON THE REMOVALBE SECTION OF THE PEDESTAL FAILED THE LOAD TEST REQUIREMENT.

title: FRUEHAUF CORPORATION: STRUCTURE (139 affected)
summary: THE MAIN BUNK RECTANGULAR TUBING AT THE END OF THE CORNER GUSSETS CAN DEVELOP STRESS CRACKS.

title: MONACO COACH CORPORATION: LIGHTING:FUSE:HEAD LIGHTS (42 affected)
summary: THE HEADLIGHT SYSTEM CAN OVERLOAD THE CIRCUIT BREAKER AND CAUSE IT TO TRIP WHEN THE HEADLIGHTS ARE ON FOR AN EXTENDED PERIOD OF TIME, RESULTING IN  LOSS OF HEADLIGHTS.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:STARTER RELAY (77,407 affected)
summary: THE STARTER RELAY MAY SHORT CIRCUIT WHEN THE VEHICLE IS PARKED.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:PEDALS AND LINKAGES (600 affected)
summary: THE RETAINER CLIP WHICH SECURES THE MASTER CYLINDER INPUT ROD TO THE BRAKE PEDAL WAS NOT INSTALLED PROPERLY, AND COULD WORK LOOSE.

title: General Motors, LLC: LIGHTING:FUSE:UNSPECIFIED LIGHT (6,013 affected)
summary: THE FOG LAMPS, LOW BEAM HEADLAMPS, AND HIGH BEAM HEADLAMPS CAN BE OPERATED SIMULTANEOUSLY. THIS CAN CAUSE THE HEADLAMP CIRCUIT BREAKER TO OVERLOAD AND TRIP, RESULTING IN LOSS OF HEADLAMPS (LOW AND HIGH BEAM) AND FOG LIGHTS.

title: HOLIDAY RAMBLER CORP.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACK ANCHORS AND SEATS (10,350 affected)
summary: THE DRIVER AND PASSENGER FRONT OUTBOARD OCCUPANT SEAT HAVE BEEN DESIGNED WITH THE SAFETY BELT ANCHORAGE ON THE SEAT STRUCTURE. IT IS POSSIBLE, IN A VEHICLE CRASH, THAT THE SEAT STRUCTURE WOULD FAIL TO WITHSTAND THE FORCES WITHIN THE LIMITS SET FORTH IN FMVSS 207 AND FMVSS 210.

title: Cummins, Inc.: FUEL:FUEL PUMP (51,635 affected)
summary: BOSCH DISTRIBUTOR-TYPE FUEL PUMPS HAVE A MANUFACTURING DEFECT THAT CAN CAUSE THE BALL PIN, WHICH IS PART OF THE PUMP'S CONTROL LEVER ASSEMBLY, TO BREAK CAUSING THE LINK BETWEEN THE CONTROL SLEEVE AND THE CONTROL LEVER TO BECOME INOPERATIVE.

title: PETERBILT MOTOR COMPANY: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (6,300 affected)
summary: SINGLE THICKNESS TETHER SAFETY BELTS CAN BREAK UNDER THE STRESSES CREATED DURING A VEHICLE CRASH. THE SAFETY BELTS DO NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS 207 AND 210.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:LATCHES AND LOCKS (912 affected)
summary: THE ELECTRIC VANDAL LOCK CENTER PLUNGER CAN TAP THE CONTROL LOCK PIN, OF THE OUTWARD OPENING DOOR, WHICH CAUSES THE DOOR LOCK TO BECOME DISENGAGED.

title: General Motors, LLC: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:BRAKE LIGHTS (140,661 affected)
summary: THE SERVICE BRAKE STOP LAMP SWITCH BECOMES INOPERATIVE.

title: KELLY SPRINGFIELD TIRE CO: TIRES (3,634 affected)
summary: THE LOAD RANGE AND THE MAXIMUM LOAD FOR THESE TIRES WAS INCORRECTLY MARKED ON THE TIRE SIDEWALL. THE TIRES SHOULD BE LOAD RANGE C, MAXIMUM LOAD 2470 LBS. AT 50 PSI (SINGLE) AND 2270 LBS. AT 50 PSI (DUAL).

title: DENMAN TIRE CORPORATION: TIRES (569 affected)
summary: THE TIRES DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE ENDURANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 119.

title: General Motors, LLC: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (6,656 affected)
summary: A MANUFACTURING CONDITION IN THE THROTTLE BODY INJECTOR (TBI) UNIT MIGHT OCCUR TO ALLOW THE THROTTLE CAM LEVER TO DISENGAGE FROM THE THROTTLE DRIVE SHAFT.
